name: Lopera
bio: Archetype: Bullet, Crit Conversion, Array. ⌽ On triggering a Bullet effect: Gains 1 Moxie and heals 50% lost HP for the ally with the lowest HP. ⌽ S2 grants [Flaming Bullet] to self. Does a FUA at turn end if there are remaining bullets on self. ⌽ Using S1 converts all bullets on self to bullets that boost Incantation/Ult Might, and distributes them to allies in front of/behind her respectively. ⌽ Array on Ult prevents bullet loss and grants +40% Crit Rate. Also allows allies to convert excess Crit Rate to Crit DMG at a bullet-determined efficiency.
